name: utf8-octets-non-ascii
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.19 (ASN.1 unaligned PER): s2 "héllo €" is 10 UTF-8 octets (e-acute 2, euro sign 3): length 0 0001010, then the octets at the cursor with no alignment (ruling 6). 207 bits, padded with 1 zero bits to 26 octets. Derived without an engine by a standalone X.691 reference program (Python standard library) and checked against two independent ASN.1 UPER codecs on the ASN.1 module in the pack header: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper; asn1tools checks y (INTEGER (-5..MAX)) only as a length and octets, because it encodes a semi-constrained integer as an unconstrained one, which X.691 does not.
